compiled a. the instance of Naubat Rāya. contains Kāyasthānvayabhāskara of Lakṣmīnārāyaṇa with his own C., Kāyasthakulamañjūṣā by Vijayarāja, Kāyasthakulacandrikā by Rāmacaraṇa of Gaṇeśapur.

Pt.. with Bengali notes an. transl., Tattvāmbudhi
